questions.question: If sqrt {5x - 6} + sqrt {5x + 6} = 6, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
We can do this question by checking the options

Let x = - 4

⇒ √{5 (- 4) – 6}, negative term in the square root which is not correct

⇒ option 1 is not Ans

Let x = 0

⇒ √{0 – 6} = √(- 6), negative term in the square root which is not correct

⇒ option 2 is not Ans

Let x = 2

⇒ √{5 (2) – 6} + √{5 (2) + 6}

⇒ √4 + √16 = 2 + 4 = 6 = RHS

⇒ option 3 is Ans

Let x = - 4

⇒ √{5 (4) – 6} + √{5 (4) + 6} , which is not equal to 6

⇒ option 4 is not Ans

∴ the Ans is x = 2

questions.question: The side BC of ΔABC is produced to D. If ∠ACD = 114° and ∠ABC = (1/2)∠BAC, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠BAC?
questions.solution:
Let ∠ABC be x then ∠BAC = 2x

Using Exterior angle property

⇒ ∠CAB + ∠ABC = ∠ ACD

⇒ 2x + x = 114

⇒ x = 38

⇒ ∠BAC = 2x = 2 × 38 = 76

∴ ∠BAC is 76

questions.question: O is the center of the circle and two tangents are drawn from a point P to this circle at points A and B. If ∠AOP = 50°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠APB?
questions.solution:
Since we know that ∠POA = ∠POB = 50

⇒ ∠AOB = 50 + 50 = 100

Now in quadrilateral PAOB

⇒ ∠APB + ∠PAO + ∠AOB + ∠OBP = 360

⇒ ∠BPA = 360 - 90 - 90 - 100 = 80 (∵∠PAO = 90 and ∠AOB = 90 because they are tangent)

∴ ∠APB = 80

questions.question: Diameter of wheel of a cycle is 21 cm. The cyclist takes 45 minutes to reach a destination at a speed of 16.5 km/hr. How many revolutions will the wheel make during the journey?
questions.solution:
Perimeter of tyre can be given as = πD = (22/7) × 21

⇒ Perimeter of tyre = 66 cm = .00066 km

Distance covered by cyclist in 45 minutes or 45/60 hrs can be given as

⇒ 16.5 × (45/60)

⇒ 16.5 × 3/4

Revolution can be given as total distance covered by cycle/perimeter of tyre

⇒ 16.5 × 3/(4 × .00066) = 18750

∴ The total revolutions are 18750

questions.question: In what ratio tea at Rs. 240/kg should be mixed with tea at Rs. 280/kg so that on selling the mixture at Rs. 324/kg there is a profit of 20%?
questions.solution:
Let the amount of tea having rate of Rs. 240/kg be a kg and that of tea having rate of 280/kg be b kg

Total amount at which it is sold = 240a + 280b

And the rate for mixture is given as Rs. (240a + 280b)/(a + b) /kg

After 20% profit on this rate it is equal to 324

⇒ {(240a + 280b)/(a + b)} × (1 + 20/100) = 324

⇒ 240a + 280b = 270a + 270b

⇒ 10b = 30a

⇒ a/b = 1/3

∴ The required ratio is 1 : 3

questions.question: A and B do (3/5)th part of a work and the rest of the work is completed by C. If A, B and C take the same work for Rs. 5000, then what is the share of C (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Given that 3/5th of the work is done by A and B, so the work done by C is given as

⇒ 1 - 3/5 = 2/5th of the total work

⇒ Share of C is 2/5th of Rs 5000

⇒ C’s share = 2 × 5000/5 = Rs. 2000

∴ The share of C is Rs. 2000

questions.question: A solid cone of height 36 cm and radius of base 9 cm is melted to form a solid cylinder of radius 9 cm and height 9 cm. What percent of material is wasted this process?
questions.solution:
Volume of cone is (1/3)πr²h

⇒ Volume of cone = (1/3) π (9)² × 36 = 972 π cm³

Volume of Cylinder is = πr²h

⇒ Volume of cylinder = π (9)² × 9 = 729 π

Volume wasted can be given as Volume of cone – volume of cylinder

⇒ 972 π - 729 π = 243 π

⇒ Percentage of wastage material is 243 π × 100/972 π = 25%

∴ The wasted material is 25%

questions.question: Profit obtained on selling an article for Rs. 540 is equal to the loss incurred on selling the article for Rs. 370. If selling price is Rs. 910, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let its cost price be Rs. x

From the problem’s statement

⇒ 540 - x = x – 370

⇒ 2x = 910

⇒ x = 455

If it was sold for Rs. 910

⇒ Profit = 910 - 455 = 455

⇒ Profit % = Profit × 100/CP = 455 × 100/455

⇒ Profit % = 100

∴ The profit percentage will be 100%

questions.question: In 2017 the sales of each brand increased by the same percentage as it did in the year 2016. What will be the approximate average sales (in units) of mobiles per brand in year 2017?
questions.solution:
Total sale of 2015 = 5.5 + 5 + 6.5 + 8.5 = 25.5

Total sale in 2016 = 7.5 + 6 + 7.5 + 9.5 = 30.5

⇒ Percentage increase in the sale = (30.5 - 25.5) × 100/25.5

⇒ Percentage increase in sale is 19.6%

Sale in 2017 is 19.6% more of that in 2016

⇒ Sale in 2017 = 30.5 × (1 + 19.6/100) = 30.5 × 1.196

⇒ Sale in 2017 = 36.478

Average sale can be given as

⇒ 36.478/4 = 9.1195

Since we know that the scale given is × 1000

⇒ average sale = 9.1195 × 1000 = 9119.5

∴ the average sale is 9120 units

questions.question: How many numbers are there from 300 to 700 which are divisible by 2, 3 and 7?
questions.solution:
Since we know that LCM of 2, 3 and 7 is 42

And the 1st number just after 300 and divisible by 42 can be written as 42 × 8 = 336

And the Last number divisible by 42 and less than 700 can be written as 42 × 16 = 672

⇒ Numbers between 700 and 300 which are divisible by 42 are 16 - 8 + 1 = 9

∴ Numbers from 300 to 700 which are divisible by 2, 3 and 7 are 9

questions.question: In an examination 65% students pass in history and 55% students pass in hindi. If 5% students failed in both the subjects, then what is the percentage of students who have passed in both the subjects?
questions.solution:
The percentage of students who have passes both subjects is given as

⇒ Percentage of students pass in history + Percentage of students who pass in Hindi + percentage of students who failed in history and Hindi – total percentage of students(i.e 100%)

⇒ Percentage of students who have passed in both subjects = 65 + 55 + 5 – 100 = 25%

**∴ The percentage of students who have passed in both subjects is 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e1b51511572af597e70611223e29199de90155f7e2b652474e120967b9d5532.png] 

Here, Total = 100x

ax = Percentage of students pass in history

cx = Percentage of students pass in Hindi

bx = Percentage of students who passed both subjects

dx = Percentage of students who did not pass any subject 

We can see that, 

⇒ ax + cx - bx + dx = 100x

⇒ 65x + 55x - b + 5x = 100x 

⇒ 125x - bx = 100x

⇒ - bx = 100x - 125x = -25x

⇒ b = 25

∴ The percentage of students who have passed both subjects is 25%

questions.question: What is the simplified value of [2/(cot A - tan A)]?
questions.solution:
Cot A can be written as cot A = 1/tan A

⇒ [2/(cot A - tan A)]

⇒ [2/{(1/tan A) - tan A}]

⇒ [2tan A/(1 - tan² A)] = tan 2A

∴ Its simplified value is tan 2A

questions.question: A person invested a total sum of Rs. 7900 in three different schemes of simple interest at 3%, 5% and 8% per annum. At the end of one year he got same interest in all three schemes. What is the money (in Rs.) invested at 3%?
questions.solution:
Let the amount in 3% be x, in 5% be y and then in 8% is (7900 - x - y)

According to the problem statement, Since the interest after 1 year is same

⇒ (x × 3 × 1 )/100 = (y × 5 × 1)/100 = {(7900 - x - y) × 8 × 1}/100

Using first two relations

⇒ 3x = 5y

⇒ y = 3x/5 ----(i)

Solving 1st and 3rd equation

⇒ 3x = 63200 – 8x – 8y Using (i)

⇒ 11x = 63200 - 8 × (3x/5)

⇒ (79x)/5 = 63200

⇒ x = 4000

∴ The money invested in 3% is Rs. 4000

questions.question: What is the simplified value of sqrt {frac{{cosec A - 1}}{{cosec A + 1}}} ?
questions.solution:
Put cosec A = 1/sin A

⇒ √[{(1/sin A) - 1}/{(1/sin A) + 1}]

⇒ √[{1 - sin A}/{1 + sin A}] Now rationalize

⇒ √[{1 - sin A}²/{1 - sin² A}] Since we know that 1 - sin² A = cos² A

⇒ √[{1 - sin A}²/cos² A]

⇒ (1 - sin A)/cos A

⇒ sec A – tan A

∴ the simplified value of the given expression is sec A - tan A

questions.question: If 2x + (1)/({2x)} = 2, then what is the value of sqrt {2{{( {(1)/(x)} )}⁴} + {{( {(1)/(x)} )}⁵}} ?
questions.solution:
2x + 1/2x = 2 is only possible when 2x = 1

⇒ 2x = 1

⇒ x = ½

Put this in the required equation

⇒ √[2 × {1/(1/2)}⁴ + {1/(1/2)}⁵]

⇒ √(2 × 2⁴ + 2⁵) 

⇒ √(32 + 32) 

⇒ √64

⇒ 8

questions.question: The average age of Ram and Rahim is 18 years. The average age of Rahim and Ramesh is 25 years. The average age of Ram and Ramesh is 29 years. What is the age (in years) of the eldest of the three?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Ram, Rahim and Ramesh be p, q and r respectively

Given that the average age of Ram and Rahim is 18 years, it can be written as

⇒ (p + q)/2 = 18

⇒ p + q = 36 ----(i)

Given that the average age of Rahim and Ramesh is 25 years, it can be written as

⇒ (q + r)/2 = 25

⇒ q + r = 50 ----(ii)

Given that the average age of Ram and Ramesh is 29 years, it can be written as

⇒ (p + r)/2 = 29

⇒ p + r = 58 ----(iii)

(iii) - (ii)

⇒ p - q = 8 ----(iv)

(i) + (iv)

⇒ 2p = 44

⇒ p = 22 Use this in (iv)

⇒ 22 - q = 8

⇒ q = 14 Put this in (ii)

⇒ 14 + r = 50

⇒ r = 36

∴ The age of eldest one is 36 years
